t: This is the site of the Shakespeare Theatre, a former theatre in Battersea, near Clapham Junction in the London Borough of Wandsworth. It takes its name from William Shakespeare, the playwright and poet often called the Bard of Avon, whose plays are performed more often than those of any other playwright. The theatre was designed by W. G. R. Sprague, an architect who was apprenticed to Frank Matcham and went on to design at least thirty-five theatres between 1890 and 1929, many of them still standing and listed in London.
